messages:
olivia: Customer (acct: acct_8X9Q) opened an escalation — Feb invoice INV-2026-021 shows 3,098,742 tokens billed but the console / usage API for the same window shows ~1,076,821. Customer is disputing ~$12.4k. Can we triage?

samir: Thanks. Can you paste the invoice id + link and customer email? Also any screenshots they sent.

olivia: Invoice: INV-2026-021, customer email: ops@acme.example, dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/acct_8X9Q/usage?range=2026-02. Customer attached screenshot of invoice and a CSV export from our usage UI. They also said they received repeated 502s earlier that week.

kevin: Automated check (billing-systems) — ran quick ledger scan. Found anomalous cluster: 2,021,921 usage_event rows for acct_8X9Q between 2026-02-10T03:00Z and 2026-02-10T03:07Z. Expected ~100k. Possible duplicate ingestion window. Posting summary: 
```
anomalies: [ {window_start: '2026-02-10T03:00Z', window_end: '2026-02-10T03:07Z', events: 2021921, dup_group_estimate: 1_000_000 } ]
```

maria: That aligns with SRE alerts — we had an NLB/edge proxy flapping for ~7m that morning. My hypothesis: client retries (with new request ids) got ingested as distinct usage events, dedupe keyed on request_id so they bypassed dedupe. Need to confirm if payloads share identical content_hash.

jess: I ran a quick SQL to group on content_hash vs request_id: 
```
SELECT content_hash, count(*) as cnt, min(request_id) as sample_request
FROM usage_events
WHERE account_id='acct_8X9Q' AND received_at BETWEEN '2026-02-10' AND '2026-02-11'
GROUP BY content_hash
HAVING cnt > 1
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Result: found ~1,032,014 rows where content_hash repeats >=2 and many distinct request_ids. So duplicates are real.

maria: Confirmed. Root cause: edge proxy retries created new request_ids; ingestion dedupe only used request_id as key. I'll patch dedupe to include content_hash + truncated payload + client_request_id when available. Hotfix ETA 15m.

samir: OK — ops path sounds good. For short-term customer help: finance needs a provisional credit if ledger shows overcharge. How much delta do we show?

jess: Calculated by running token summarization collapse on content_hash: canonical_tokens = 1,076,821; raw_billed_tokens = 3,098,742; duplicate_tokens = 2,021,921. Token rate for Feb (hosted text-gen) = $0.006 / 1k tokens -> billed amount delta ~= (2,021,921 / 1000) * 0.006 = $12.131526 ~ $12.13k.

kevin: Finance automation suggests provisional credit = $12,131.53 rounded. Posting ledger diff preview (mock): 
```
ledger_diff: {
  acct: 'acct_8X9Q',
  invoice: 'INV-2026-021',
  original_tokens: '3098742',
  corrected_tokens: '1076821',
  refund_amount: '12131.53',
  gl_codes: ['4000-SALES', '8400-REVREC_ADJ']
}
```

finance-bot: Finance action required -> create REFUND ticket in Zendesk with type=provisional_credit, amount=12131.53, memo='metering dedupe — pending backfill verification'. Assign to @kevin-fin.

samir: I'll approve provisional credit once SRE confirms hotfix deployed and backfill plan. Can someone draft the customer message so CS can send an interim reply?

olivia: Draft for CS: "Hi — thanks for flagging. We found duplicate usage events during a 7m window on Feb 10 due to edge retries. We're applying a provisional credit of $12,131.53 while we backfill dedupe and generate a corrected invoice. We'll update you once finalized and provide the adjusted invoice. Apologies for the trouble." Thoughts?

maria: Ship it. Also note: we need to run a backfill script that collapses duplicates by content_hash and emits corrected usage summary events to billing. Backfill plan: 1) snapshot affected events, 2) collapse on content_hash keeping earliest received_at, 3) generate delta feed for billing pipeline, 4) re-run invoice generation in dry-run, 5) produce final invoice after finance sign-off. Estimate 2-3h for full backfill.

jess: I'll open PR for dedupe change (include content_hash and client_request_id) and a migration script to retroactively tag suspected duplicates. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ingestion/pull/4421 (WIP).

kevin: Finance note for revrec: "Revenue reversal pending verification. Provisional credit booked as liability (8400-REVREC_ADJ) until backfill completes. Expected impact: reduce recognized revenue for Feb 2026 by $12,131.53 if confirmed." Please add this to the finance ticket.

finance-bot: FIN_TICKET_2026-998 created -> link: https://finance.redwood.ai/tickets/FIN_TICKET_2026-998 assigned to @kevin. Include provisional GL entries and revrec note.

olivia: Customer reply: "Thanks for the quick response. Please proceed with the provisional credit and let us know when the corrected invoice is ready." They asked for ETA. I'll tell them ~3h.

samir: +1 provisional credit approved. Please tag me once hotfix is deployed.

sre-ops: Hotfix deployed to ingestion dedupe service at 2026-02-10T03:40Z; toggled feature flag 'dedupe_contenthash' = ON. Monitoring for any regressions.

maria: Backfill started: job id BACKFILL-2026-02-10-acct_8X9Q. Currently at 12% — writing collapsed events to billing-delta topic. Estimated completion 2h.

jess: Backfill script snippet we used (for auditors): 
```
# collapse duplicates by content_hash
WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT content_hash, min(received_at) as keep_at, sum(tokens) as tokens
  FROM usage_events
  WHERE account_id='acct_8X9Q' AND received_at BETWEEN '2026-02-10' AND '2026-02-11'
  GROUP BY content_hash
)
INSERT INTO billing_delta (account_id, event_time, tokens, source)
SELECT 'acct_8X9Q', keep_at, tokens, 'backfill_dedupe_2026-02-10' FROM grouped;
```

kevin: Finance will hold provisional credit in the liability bucket. When backfill completes, run corrected invoice drafter and attach revrec final note. After final confirmation we will issue the refund or adjust next invoice as per customer preference.

olivia: Customer updated: "We prefer a credit to next invoice." Noted.

maria: Backfill completed at 2026-02-10T06:23Z. Results: collapsed_tokens = 1,076,821 canonical, delta_tokens = 2,021,921 removed. Emitted billing_delta topic message and flagged invoice INV-2026-021 as 'needs_regen'.

jess: Ran invoice regenerate in dry-run -> corrected invoice amount delta matches provisional credit. Opened final PR to billing to apply corrected invoice and mark original as superseded: https://git.redwood/invoice/PR-1987.

kevin: Finance confirms — finalize revrec entry: "Decrease recognized revenue 2026-02 by $12,131.53 for acct_8X9Q due to duplicate ingestion during transient edge retry period. GL: debit 8400-REVREC_ADJ, credit 4000-SALES." Posting to FIN_TICKET_2026-998.

finance-bot: Refund action queued as 'credit_next_invoice' per customer preference. Customer will see credit on their next statement.

olivia: Sent final note to customer with corrected invoice attached and credit confirmed. They replied :thumbsup: — 'thank you, appreciate the quick response'.

samir: Closing checklist: 1) dedupe change merged + deployed -> jess (done), 2) backfill completed -> maria (done), 3) corrected invoice issued -> kevin (done), 4) finance ticket closed when credit applied -> kevin. I'll mark this resolved once finance confirms ledger reconciliation.

kevin: Ledger reconciliation completed and FIN_TICKET_2026-998 closed. Final note: post-mortem scheduled for Friday to discuss improving observability on ingestion retries and adding a real-time duplicate-detector alert.

olivia: Thanks everyone. Closing thread.
